method: Agent-reviewed observational annotations from independent TShark dissection, ARP identities, DNS link/answer evidence, SYN concentration and HTTP bytes. No Mini-NIDS alerts were used to create these intervals. Not official CIC labels and not independently certified by another human.
unit: observed campaign/poison interval, not individual packet or every scan pass
boundary_policy: First/last visible evidence; tails outside capture remain unknown. Zero evaluator tolerance; limits/uncertainty are discussed.
